correctness: All differential cases, equal single validation-walk counts, expected selection and command-buffer reduction, lifecycle checks must pass.
deviceAcceptance: Only after host and representative coverage gates pass: at least three paired controlled A/B trials, source/native total-frame-time median improves at least 3 percent, p95 regresses no more than 2 percent, same workload and conditions, no correctness or input-latency regression. Driver-call counts alone never pass.
limits: NOOP has no real Vulkan/driver management cost. A host cost loss stops this prototype under the conservative offline gate; it does not prove every possible driver or future implementation must lose. No extrapolated driver savings may turn a failed gate into success.
